mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses equity discount rates, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns as investors shift capital toward equities from fixed income.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0% over a 5-year rolling window, or Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.3 percentage point increase in unemployment rate over three months signals deteriorating labor conditions, triggering negative S&P 500 returns as earnings growth expectations decline.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE rises > 0.3pp in 3 months, or Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in payroll growth and housing starts indicate broad economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both PAYEMS and HOUST decline, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS > 4.0% and CPIAUCSL > 3.0% for three months), S&P 500 exhibits negative returns due to higher real interest rates depressing equity valuations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the regime condition, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A low unemployment rate (below 4.0%) signals robust labor market conditions supporting corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts below 1300 thousand units signal weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns as the housing sector's GDP contribution diminishes.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1300.0, or Rank IC is negative.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in industrial production and quarterly GDP growth indicate supply-side contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as manufacturing output and economic activity slow.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and GDPC1 decline, or Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes (RSAFS growth > 0.5% and HOUST > 1350.0), S&P 500 experiences negative returns as valuations become stretched and policy response risk increases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods meeting the regime condition, or Rank IC is below 0.03.
